text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon takes first!
Mihono Bourbon is your winner!
(UWAAAAAHH--!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I knew you had it in you, Mihono Bourbon!
Following in Teio's footsteps with a Double Crown, huh!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“Still, next up is the Kikuka Sho, right?
I hope I can manage to run the full 3,000 meters...”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, our Bourbon will
definitely pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Master. Order complete...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
It is all thanks to Master's guidance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Well then, for the next order—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Bourbon-san...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Extreme exhaustion confirmed due to loss of focus
and unsteady footing. Are you 'all right'?
Whether she heard Mihono Bourbon's voice or not, she mutters under her breath as if delirious.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice... couldn't catch up to Bourbon-san again...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Miss Bourbon is... incredible...
That's why I have to try harder... and harder...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
More... more... more...
Rice has to... change...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...! Rice-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...*snooze*... *snooze*...

After that, I carried Rice Shower and made sure
she woke up before leaving Tokyo Racecourse behind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master.
Rice-san is incomprehensible to me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Why is she so "obsessed" with me in the first place?
And why does she talk about "catching up"?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"The only outcomes of a race are 'victory' or 'defeat.'
Rice-san received neither—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I describe it as "catching up."
I am running in order to "catch up."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A solution regarding this meaning and intent cannot be found in my local folder.

Everyone carries their own feelings into a race.
For some Umamusume, the results aren't what matters most.
Intuition is something you can only truly understand once you've experienced it yourself.

"Mihono Bourbon already struggles to grasp emotions as it is,
so this might still be a bit difficult for her."
choice_data_list: I'm sure the day will come when you understand both.

text_block_list.text: I'll likely continue clashing with Rice Shower in the Twinkle Series from now on.

Let's not rush, and wait for the day we understand the true meaning behind it.
When I said that—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The basis is unclear, but since it is Master's opinion, I deem it worthy of implementation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will wait for the "day I'll understand."
The train quietly headed toward the Academy.

Next is the final race of the Classic Triple Crown.
The Kikuka Sho...!
